problem.observer_locked: Observer mode cannot be switched while connected. Disconnect first, then change it.
problem.nothing_to_send: Nothing to send: the message is empty, or there is neither a recipient nor a COM1 frequency

status.no_mouse_ptt: Mouse side buttons cannot be used for PTT on this system

voice.evicted: This account signed in elsewhere; voice disconnected

login.observer_note: For the right seat: voice only, without a second aircraft on the network. Each pilot needs their own account.
login.follow_tip: The callsign of the captain's aircraft. The voice server measures your range from its position.

observer.frequency_tip: Observer mode only: type a frequency and voice stays on it. Clear it to follow the cockpit COM1 again.
observer.no_frequency: No frequency yet: type one here, or keep the simulator running to follow COM1

chat.push_to_talk_tip: Hold to transmit. You can also bind a key, a mouse side button, or a joystick button in Settings.
chat.recipient: Recipient (leave blank to send on frequency)
chat.observer_no_text: Observers do not send or receive text messages

plan.offline: Not connected yet. Connect first, then file.
plan.observer: Observers are not on the network; the captain files the flight plan

local.inject_note: When off, you have the sky to yourself; voice is unaffected
local.chime: Play a chime for ATC messages
local.chime_all: Chime for every message on frequency
local.chime_all_note: By default only messages naming your callsign chime; private messages always do
local.chime_note: The chime plays on the headset selected above, not the system default device. If the preview is silent, the wrong device is selected.

hangar.dir_placeholder: Leave blank to detect automatically (reads UserCfg.opt)
hangar.found: Liveries: {liveries}, aircraft types: {types} (read from {files} aircraft.cfg files)
hangar.no_types: Liveries found: {liveries}, but not a single type code. These are probably add-ons rather than aircraft; correct the packages folder and try again.
hangar.empty: No aircraft models found, so all traffic falls back to the few built-in first-party types. The packages folder often lives on another drive; if so, enter that path here.

ptt.title: Push to talk (PTT)
ptt.unresolved: This binding is not recognised on this system; record it again
ptt.none: No bindings yet — PTT will not work
ptt.wayland: This system runs Wayland, which does not let ordinary programs listen for global keys, so keyboard PTT will not work. Use a joystick button instead.
ptt.no_mouse: Mouse side buttons cannot be used for PTT on this system.

simconnect.unavailable: SimConnect is not available on this system: the MSFS client can only reach the simulator on Windows
